text:
inc-bot: Paging: HIGH network.egress_error_rate in us-west-2a (alert for private-subnet-*) . CC @sophie oncall

sophie: got it. looking. starting checklist

sophie: checking NAT metrics CloudWatch -> natgw-0aabc... errors spiked at ~12:07 UTC

dan: multiple customers reporting 502s/timeouts. tickets: #8342, #8343 showing upstream connection failures

lisa: digging VPC route tables and recent infra changes. any deploys at ~12:04-12:06?

deploy-bot: Terraform apply completed by @tara at 12:04 UTC — changes: updated route_table rtb-0bb to add 0.0.0.0/0 -> eni-012345 (association)

tara: yes ran a small egress refactor to pin to a new NAT during canary. thought the association switched ok

omar: eni-012345 is an ENI for a terminated instance — target shows "blackhole" in route table

sophie: seeing private subnets with 0.0.0.0/0 -> eni-012345 (blackhole). rollback now. omar can you disassociate the route? I'll prepare rollback commands

omar: running describe-route-tables for rtb-0bb to confirm

omar: output snippet:
```
- DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
  NetworkInterfaceId: eni-012345
  State: blackhole
```

lisa: also noticed a NACL deny on ephemeral ports applied to those subnets from an earlier change — likely compounding failures

dan: so combined effect: route -> blackhole + NACL tightening == 502s to external APIs

sophie: remove bad route first to restore default NAT/IGW fallback. omar, run:
```
aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-0bb --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --gateway-id igw-0fff
```

omar: running now. CLI response: OK

inc-bot: deploy rollback triggered: Terraform destroy target rtb-assoc-attachment by @sophie at 12:20 UTC

tara: note — my script rotated ENIs but didn't validate ENI lifecycle; association pointed to stale ENI when instance terminated in canary

sophie: reverting NACL change as well to be safe. lisa, can you restore ephemeral allow? snippet from git: 
```
- rule_number: 32768
  protocol: tcp
  port_range: 1024-65535
  rule_action: allow
```

lisa: applied revert to NACLs. checking flows and CloudWatch metrics

sophie: egress errors dropping back to baseline on graphs — observing decreased error rate at ~12:28 UTC

dan: two customers confirmed functionality restored; updating tickets and CSMs

tara: adding immediate fix to PR: add ENI lifecycle gating + verify route target health before apply

omar: quick incident notes for PMR:
- cause: Terraform associated 0.0.0.0/0 to stale ENI -> blackhole
- contributing: simultaneous NACL tighten pushed in same window
- mitigation performed: replace-route to IGW, roll back NACL, triggered Terraform destroy on faulty assoc
- action items: preflight ENI checks, add route blackhole alert, block concurrent NACL/route changes in same deploy window

sophie: handing off to oncall-next @omar for monitoring. I'm off in 30m. tag me in RCA and timeline

omar: taking watch. will run 2h of monitoring and collect packet captures if any spikes reoccur; will collate CloudWatch/FlowLogs

inc-bot: Incident severity: Sev2 (partial customer impact). Start: 1991230000. Timeline capture enabled.

lisa: postmortem owner assigned: @tara — ETA for writeup: EOD tomorrow. I'll attach metrics + route table diffs

dan: notifying CSMs and affected customers with a brief summary + next steps/RCA ETA

sophie: closing paging loop for now. if error rate resurfaces ping pager again. :thumbsup:

inc-bot: Incident resolved/closed at 1991231800. Labels: network, vpc, terraform, rollback
